items.t: Technology outage slows CSX operations; security team rules out cyberattack
items.x: CSX is working through a technology outage that began Tuesday. The company’s security team has confirmed the disruption was not a cyberattack and that no data breach occurred, according to a spokesperson.

items.t: Federal Reserve keeps rates unchanged despite elevated inflation
items.x: The Federal Reserve kept its key rate unchanged Wednesday at about 3.9% despite stubbornly high inflation, while providing little hint about its next moves.

items.t: Timberwolves say Anthony Edwards will be 'good as new' with no long-term concern after knee surgery
items.x: The Minnesota Timberwolves believe Anthony Edwards will be “good as new” following arthroscopic surgery for a lingering injury to his right knee.

items.t: Cornell faculty to begin voting on no-confidence measure over handling of sexual assault allegations
items.x: Cornell University faculty will vote on a no-confidence measure over its handling of sexual assault allegations.

items.t: Jacksonville dog owner sentenced to six years in prison after man mauled to death in 2024
items.x: Despite receiving multiple warnings to contain his animals, police determined Melvyn Souffrount's dog killed a man on Ricker Road in August 2024.

items.t: Iran war's cost to American taxpayers grows to an estimated $47.1 billion
items.x: The cost of the Iran war to American taxpayers has grown to an estimated $47.1 billion, the Pentagon told Congress.

items.t: Jacksonville firefighter, nurse wife survive deadly Spain train crash, then treat the injured
items.x: JFRD firefighter Josue Garcia-Otero was traveling with his wife and family on a post-wedding trip when tragedy struck. That's when JFRD said his training took over.

items.t: RFK Jr. eases access to unproven peptides despite opposition from FDA scientists
items.x: The Trump administration has acted to ease access to unproven peptide drugs favored by Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr.

items.t: King tides inundate streets and flood homes and businesses along both US coasts
items.x: King tides have inundated parts of both U.S. coasts.

items.t: Conservative activists O'Keefe, Higby charged with unlawful voting in Minnesota
items.x: Conservative activists James O’Keefe and Cam Higby have been charged with unlawful voting and identity theft in Minnesota after a prosecutor said they gave false names to poll workers during the state's primary election.

items.t: Rays ace Drew Rasmussen to start World Series Game 5 on short rest against Milwaukee
items.x: Drew Rasmussen will start for Tampa Bay on three days’ rest in Game 5 of the World Series against the Milwaukee Brewers on Wednesday night, trying to stave off elimination for the Rays.

items.t: Indiana governor is urged to let death sentence proceed against man who killed 2 kids in fire
items.x: The Indiana Parole Board is recommending that the death penalty remain in place for a man who killed two children in a house fire.

items.t: Two Michigan WWII veterans celebrate 99th birthdays together
items.x: David Low and Marv Nagelkerk, who served in the Marine Corps and Navy during World War II, were honored by friends and fellow veterans on their 99th birthday.

items.t: Viral video shows delivery driver throwing package at cat, prompting investigation
items.x: A delivery driver returned to a family’s home to apologize after a viral security video appeared to show him throwing a package at their cat, Opie.

items.t: Egyptian farmer discovers two massive statues of ancient king who ruled Egypt
items.x: An Egyptian farmer came across an archeological discovery dating to an ancient king in Egypt while working on his land.

items.t: Sports broadcasting legend Ernie Johnson announces departure from 'Inside the NBA' after 2026-27 season
items.x: Sports Broadcasting Hall of Famer Ernie Johnson announced he'll leave "Inside the NBA" after the 2026-27 season, citing personal choice.

items.t: Annual Fall clock change approaches, daylight saving to end Sunday morning
items.x: Gaining an extra hour sleep is what will happen, as Georgians and many Floridians will return to true Eastern Standard Time. Clocks will change from 2 a.m. to 1 a.m.

items.t: Judge orders 'immediate' release of report, surveillance footage tied to Charles Faggart's in-custody death
items.x: Attorneys representing the family of Charles Faggart say they are "overjoyed" by the judge's ruling.

items.t: Daily Dose: New heart guidelines for women, a next-gen weight loss drug beats Ozempic and what new data reveals about profound autism
items.x: Four medical groups unveiled a lifelong heart health roadmap for women, from first period through menopause, built around key hormonal changes.

items.t: Judge orders 30-year prison sentence for key figure in Minnesota food fraud
items.x: A man who played a major role in defrauding a federal food program in Minnesota has been sentenced to 30 years in prison.
